newsitem.title: UK: KEPIT wants TREG programme trade details.
newsitem.headline: KEPIT wants TREG programme trade details.

text.p: The independent directors of Kleinwort European Privatisation Trust Plc (KEPIT) said that they had written to TR European Growth Trust (TREG) for full details of TREG's programme trade arrangements and breakdown of costs which TREG has said are outside its control.

KEPIT said its directors would review this information "to see whether it has any bearing on their assessment of the relative merits of TREG's offers and the independent directors' recommended proposal."
KEPIT said the independent directors' objective remained "to ensure the most attractive proposal is recommended to shareholders and warrantholders when KEPIT's circular is posted."
TR European is offering shareholders in KEPIT the option of getting out or rolling into their European fund.
It says that it has negotiated a programme trade for the sale of KEPIT's assets which will allow it to return as much money as possible to shareholders.
